lines.text: Many learners say: I want that you come.
Better: I want you to come.
Me to! Mom wants me to study.

native.tip: نقول want you to + فعل: “I want you to come.” وليس “I want that you come.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I want that you come.” 😅 نقول want you to + فعل، فالجملة الصحيحة “I want you to come.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “I want that you come”?
en.tip: We say want you to plus a verb: “I want you to come.” not “I want that you come.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I want that you come.” 😅 We say want you to plus a verb, so the right sentence is “I want you to come.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
